parakeet: But here's the good news. Once you see this dynamic, once you name it, you can free yourself from it. You can realize your worth doesn't depend on slogans. Your meaning doesn't require submission. Your community doesn't have to be built on defending unprovable claims. You can build a life rooted in compassion, reason, growth, and creativity. A life big enough to face the unknown without lying to yourself to feel safe. Because when you stop carrying a banner, you didn't even get to design, you finally get to build something real, something human, something free.
